notes: al-penei is split rather than fused, since the ASV spends in on the preposition and open on the construct noun, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet.
The article on sadeh takes the fronted the, the rectum itself being rendered anarthrously (rule 29).
The four bets marking what is touched are unrepresented under rule 40, the ASV writing bare English objects.
